"""Print the table of contents for a Markdown file: python -m mdtoc.cli FILE."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys

from mdtoc.headings import parse_headings
from mdtoc.render import render_toc


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    """Read the file named in argv[1] and print its table of contents."""
    with open(argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        print(render_toc(parse_headings(handle.read())), end="")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))

"""Find the headings in a Markdown document."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

HEADING = re.compile(r"^(#{1,6})\s+(.*?)(?:\s+#+)?\s*$")


def extract_headings(text: str) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    """Return (level, title) for every ATX heading, in document order."""
    found = []
    in_fence = False
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("```"):
            in_fence = not in_fence
            continue
        match = None if in_fence else HEADING.match(line)
        if match:
            found.append((len(match.group(1)), match.group(2)))
    return found

"""Render a table of contents as a nested Markdown list."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re


def slug(title: str) -> str:
    """GitHub-style anchor: lowercase, punctuation dropped, spaces to hyphens."""
    return re.sub(r"[^\w\- ]", "", title.strip().lower()).replace(" ", "-")


def render_toc(headings: list[tuple[int, str]], numbered: bool = False) -> str:
    """One '- [Title](#slug)' line per heading (or '1.2.' numbers), two spaces per level."""
    if not headings:
        return ""
    top = min(level for level, _ in headings)
    counters: list[int] = []
    lines = []
    for level, title in headings:
        depth = level - top
        counters = counters[: depth + 1] + [0] * (depth + 1 - len(counters))
        counters[depth] += 1
        marker = ".".join(map(str, counters)) + "." if numbered else "-"
        lines.append(f"{'  ' * depth}{marker} [{title}](#{slug(title)})")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

    if not headings:
